title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
abstract: arXiv:2610.18325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Virtual footwear try-on (VFTON), a critical yet underexplored area in virtual try-on (VTON), aims to synthesize faithful try-on results given diverse footwear and model images while maintaining 3D consistency and texture authenticity. Unlike conventional garment-focused VTON methods, VFTON presents unique challenges due to (1) Data Scarcity, which arises from the difficulty of perfectly matching product shoes with models wearing the identical ones, (2) Viewpoint Misalignment, where the target foot pose and source shoe views are always misaligned, leading to incomplete texture information and detail distortion, and (3) Background-induced Color Distortion, where complex material of footwear interacts with environmental lighting, causing unintended color contamination. To address these challenges, we introduce MVShoes, a multi-view shoe try-on dataset consisting of 7305 well-annotated image triplets, covering diverse footwear categories a

translated_title: ShoeFit：用于虚拟鞋类试穿的新数据集与双图像流DiT框架
translated_abstract: 虚拟鞋类试穿（VFTON）是虚拟试穿（VTON）中一个关键但尚未被充分探索的领域，旨在根据多样的鞋类和模特图像合成逼真的试穿效果，同时保持3D一致性和纹理真实性。与传统的以服装为中心的VTON方法不同，VFTON面临着独特的挑战：（1）数据稀缺，源于难以将产品鞋与穿着完全相同鞋子的模特完美匹配；（2）视角错位，即目标脚部姿态与源鞋视图总是无法对齐，导致纹理信息不完整和细节失真；（3）背景引起的颜色失真，即鞋类复杂材质与环境光照相互作用，导致意外的颜色污染。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MVShoes，一个由7305个标注良好的图像三元组组成的多视角鞋类试穿数据集，涵盖多样的鞋类类别……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个多视角鞋类试穿数据集MVShoes（包含7305个标注图像三元组）以及双图像流DiT框架ShoeFit，通过解决数据稀缺、视角错位和颜色失真三大挑战，实现了兼具3D一致性与纹理真实性的高保真虚拟鞋类试穿。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MVShoes, a multi-view footwear try-on dataset with 7305 well-annotated image triplets, and ShoeFit, a dual-image-stream DiT framework, achieving high-fidelity virtual footwear try-on with 3D consistency and texture authenticity by addressing data scarcity, viewpoint misalignment, and background-induced color distortion.
